sloka: ततस्त्वजामुखी नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।विशस्येमां ततः सर्वान्समान्कुरुत पीलुकान् ।। ५.२२.३८।।।।
transliteration: tatastvajāmukhī nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt ।viśasyemāṁ tataḥ sarvānsamānkuruta pīlukān ।। 5.22.38।।।।

translations.english: The demon king repeatedly commanded the ogresses burning in anger and passion and threatened Sita again and again, pointing his finger at her.
